records.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: rehabilitation exercise step photograph, 113 T-LOW-036 s01, start position for supported single-leg calf raise on a level floor.
Input images: reference-01, reference-02 and reference-03 are identity, clothing and studio-style references. The existing 113 image is only a reference for identity, camera and fixed rail, NOT a pose or equipment reference. DO NOT copy its dumbbell or bare feet.
Create ONE photorealistic studio photograph. Preserve the same adult East Asian woman, dark ponytail, plain short-sleeve white T-shirt and dark charcoal straight athletic trousers as the references. She now wears ordinary unbranded white low-top athletic shoes, both complete and anatomically correct.
Scene: light gray-blue seamless studio background and level matte floor, gentle diffused studio lighting and soft natural contact shadows. A sturdy fixed gray horizontal waist-height handrail stands at the right, with a vertical column and floor attachment visible, no unstable furniture.
Pose: full-body true side view facing to image right. The camera-near LEFT leg is the TRAINING leg, aligned beneath her hip. This left training foot is completely flat on the level floor: heel and forefoot sole BOTH visibly contact the floor. The far RIGHT knee is bent back modestly, the complete right shoe held clearly 8–12 cm above the floor behind the planted ankle, with an unmistakable strip of background below the whole sole. The right foot does NOT touch the left leg or the floor. One hand reaches forward and rests naturally on the fixed handrail; the free hand hangs relaxed by her thigh and holds nothing. Torso upright, shoulders and pelvis stable, training knee naturally nearly straight without forced locking.
Composition: portrait full body from hair through both complete shoes with generous margins, normal human proportions, accurate fingers visibly connected to the woman's arm, feet and knees unobscured. Eye-level side camera, natural 70 mm lens appearance. Both feet easy to distinguish.
Constraints: single frame, no collage, no insets, no duplicate people, no ghost poses, no text, no numbers, no arrows, no graphic marks or logos, no watermark. NO dumbbell, NO weight, NO step or platform, NO barefoot person, NO raised training heel in this start frame.

Do NOT generate a new composition.
Single required change: lower BOTH bare heels all the way onto the LEVEL floor. BOTH left and right feet are now completely flat, from heel through ball/forefoot, with obvious realistic heel-to-floor contact and soft grounded contact shadows. The nearer LEFT foot remains nearest camera; the farther RIGHT foot remains in its existing behind-the-near-foot visual offset so each bare foot can be distinguished. Both knees remain naturally nearly straight and relaxed, body settled and steady, one hand still on the fixed gray rail. No shoe is to be added. Feet must look anatomically natural with complete toes, soles and heels, no stretched foot or rotated shoe-like shape.
Retain the waist/chest-to-floor close-up framing, both knees, complete bare feet, supporting forearm and hand, stable gray rail and base. No caption, no arrows or graphic marks, no watermark, no inset, no split screen, no double exposure or duplicate limbs. No step, platform, weights or added props. The key proof in this s01 frame is TWO full-foot supports on the level floor, BOTH heels genuinely resting on floor, and the same fixed hand support as s02.
